report_identity.report_title: LEE KEE HOLDINGS LIMITED ANNUAL REPORT 2024/2025

business_overview.one_sentence: Lee Kee is principally engaged in trading zinc, zinc alloy, nickel, nickel-related products, aluminium, aluminium alloy, stainless steel and other electroplating chemical products, with operations viewed by Hong Kong and Mainland China segments.
business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is recognised from sale of goods when customers take possession of and accept metal products; contracts are generally within one year.
business_notes: FY2025 revenue HK$2.049b, up 20.6%; tonnage sold about 85,100 tonnes.
Gross margin stayed at about 4.0%, indicating a high-turnover, low-margin metals distribution model.
